installs: A Claude Code marketplace manifest at .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, registered with /plugin marketplace add and then installed entry by entry with /plugin install <name>@agent-toolkit; each entry names a source directory under dist/plugins/, which scripts/build_plugins.py generates from the repository's skills/, agents/, and commands/ trees. The README also documents npx skills add softaworks/agent-toolkit for Agent Skills hosts and cp -r skills/<name> ~/.claude/skills/ by hand. The README says the skills-installer path also works with Codex, Cursor, and other agents, but documents an install only for Claude Code, so only Claude Code is recorded as a host. This record pins the manifest and does not list, count, or review its entries.
distribution_machinery: scripts/build_plugins.py generates the dist/plugins/ tree the manifest resolves against, and scripts/bump_version.py raises the manifest version. Neither is installed into a host; both operate on the repository's own files.
not_a_system: A marketplace manifest that lists other packs for installation; it is an install source, not a system, and this record never lists, counts, or reviews its entries.
